verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר נִבְנְתָה֙ הַחוֹמָ֔ה וָאַעֲמִ֖יד הַדְּלָת֑וֹת וַיִּפָּֽקְד֛וּ הַשּׁוֹעֲרִ֥ים וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֖ים וְהַלְוִיִּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer niḇ·nə·ṯāh ha·ḥō·w·māh wā·’a·‘ă·mîḏ had·də·lā·ṯō·wṯ way·yip·pā·qə·ḏū haš·šō·w·‘ă·rîm wə·ham·šō·rə·rîm wə·hal·wî·yim
verses.literal: When the wall had been rebuilt and I had set the doors in place the gatekeepers singers and Levites were appointed
verses.literalPt: Ora, depois que o muro tinha sido edificado, e eu tinha assentado as portas, e foram apontados os porteiros, os cantores e os levitas,

verses.original: וָאֲצַוֶּ֞ה אֶת־ חֲנָ֣נִי אָחִ֗י וְאֶת־ חֲנַנְיָ֛ה שַׂ֥ר הַבִּירָ֖ה עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כִּי־ הוּא֙ כְּאִ֣ישׁ אֱמֶ֔ת וְיָרֵ֥א אֶת־ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים מֵרַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ- ḥă·nā·nî ’ā·ḥî wə·’eṯ- ḥă·nan·yāh śar hab·bî·rāh ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim kî- hū kə·’îš ’ĕ·meṯ wə·yā·rê ’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm mê·rab·bîm
verses.literal: Then I put my brother Hanani in charge of Jerusalem along with Hananiah the commander of the fortress because he was a faithful man who feared God more than most
verses.literalPt: entreguei a Hanani, meu irmão, e a Hananias, governador do castelo, o cargo de Jerusalém; pois ele era homem fiel e temia a Deus mais do que muitos.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר לָהֶ֗ם לֹ֣א יִפָּֽתְח֞וּ שַׁעֲרֵ֤י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ עַד־ חֹ֣ם הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ וְעַ֨ד הֵ֥ם עֹמְדִ֛ים יָגִ֥יפוּ הַדְּלָת֖וֹת וֶאֱחֹ֑זוּ וְהַעֲמֵ֗יד מִשְׁמְרוֹת֙ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם אִ֚ישׁ בְּמִשְׁמָר֔וֹ וְאִ֖ישׁ נֶ֥גֶד בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mɛr lā·hem lō yip·pā·ṯə·ḥū ša·‘ă·rê yə·rū·šā·lim ‘aḏ- ḥōm haš·še·meš wə·‘aḏ hêm ‘ō·mə·ḏîm yā·ḡî·p̄ū had·də·lā·ṯō·wṯ we·’ĕ·ḥō·zū wə·ha·‘ă·mêḏ miš·mə·rō·wṯ yō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim ’îš bə·miš·mā·rōw wə·’îš ne·ḡeḏ bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: And I told them Do not open the gates of Jerusalem until the sun is hot While the guards are on duty keep the doors shut and securely fastened And appoint the residents of Jerusalem as guards some at their posts and some at their own homes
verses.literalPt: Eu lhes disse: Não se abram as portas de Jerusalém, até que o sol faça sentir o seu calor; estando presentes os da guarda, fechem-se e tranquem-se as portas; e apontai dos habitantes de Jerusalém guardas, cada um por seu turno e cada um diante da sua casa.

verses.original: וְהָעִ֞יר רַחֲבַ֤ת יָדַ֙יִם֙ וּגְדוֹלָ֔ה וְהָעָ֥ם מְעַ֖ט בְּתוֹכָ֑הּ וְאֵ֥ין בָּתִּ֖ים בְּנוּיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·‘îr ra·ḥă·ḇaṯ yā·ḏa·yim ū·ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh wə·hā·‘ām mə·‘aṭ bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh wə·’ên bāt·tîm bə·nū·yim
verses.literal: Now the city was large and spacious . . . but there were few people in it and the houses had not yet been rebuilt
verses.literalPt: Ora, a cidade era larga e grande, porém dentro dela era pouco o povo, e não estavam edificadas as casas.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן אֱלֹהַי֙ אֶל־ לִבִּ֔י וָאֶקְבְּצָ֞ה אֶת־ הַחֹרִ֧ים וְאֶת־ הַסְּגָנִ֛ים וְאֶת־ הָעָ֖ם לְהִתְיַחֵ֑שׂ וָֽאֶמְצָ֗א סֵ֤פֶר הַיַּ֙חַשׂ֙ הָעוֹלִ֣ים בָּרִאשׁוֹנָ֔ה וָאֶמְצָ֖א כָּת֥וּב בּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên ’ĕ·lō·hay ’el- lib·bî wā·’eq·bə·ṣāh ’eṯ- ha·ḥō·rîm wə·’eṯ- has·sə·ḡā·nîm wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ām lə·hiṯ·ya·ḥêś wā·’em·ṣā sê·p̄er hay·ya·ḥaś hā·‘ō·w·lîm bā·ri·šō·w·nāh wā·’em·ṣā kā·ṯūḇ bōw
verses.literal: Then my God put it into my heart to assemble the nobles the officials and the people to be enrolled by genealogy I found the genealogical register of those who had first returned . . . and I found the following written in it
verses.literalPt: Meu Deus me incitou a juntar os nobres, os magistrados e o povo, para que fossem contados segundo as genealogias. Achei o livro da genealogia dos que tinham subido primeiro e achei que nele estava escrito o que segue:

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה׀ בְּנֵ֣י הַמְּדִינָ֗ה הָעֹלִים֙ מִשְּׁבִ֣י הַגּוֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֶגְלָ֔ה נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַיָּשׁ֧וּבוּ לִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְלִיהוּדָ֖ה אִ֥ישׁ לְעִירֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh bə·nê ham·mə·ḏî·nāh hā·‘ō·lîm miš·šə·ḇî hag·gō·w·lāh ’ă·šer heḡ·lāh nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·neṣ·ṣar me·leḵ bā·ḇel way·yā·šū·ḇū lî·rū·šā·lim wə·lî·hū·ḏāh ’îš lə·‘î·rōw
verses.literal: These are the people of the province who came up from the captivity of the exiles carried away to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar its king They returned to Jerusalem and Judah each to his own town
verses.literalPt: Estes são os filhos da província, que subiram do cativeiro dos que tinham sido transportados por Nabucodonosor, rei da Babilônia, e que voltaram para Jerusalém e para Judá, cada um para a sua cidade,

verses.original: הַבָּאִ֣ים עִם־ זְרֻבָּבֶ֗ל יֵשׁ֡וּעַ נְחֶמְיָ֡ה עֲ֠זַרְיָה רַֽעַמְיָ֨ה נַחֲמָ֜נִי מָרְדֳּכַ֥י בִּלְשָׁ֛ן מִסְפֶּ֥רֶת בִּגְוַ֖י נְח֣וּם בַּעֲנָ֑ה מִסְפַּ֕ר אַנְשֵׁ֖י עַ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: hab·bā·’îm ‘im- zə·rub·bā·ḇel yê·šū·a‘ nə·ḥem·yāh ‘ă·zar·yāh ra·‘am·yāh na·ḥă·mā·nî mā·rə·do·ḵay bil·šān mis·pe·reṯ biḡ·way nə·ḥūm ba·‘ă·nāh mis·par ’an·šê ‘am yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: accompanied by Zerubbabel Jeshua Nehemiah Azariah Raamiah Nahamani Mordecai Bilshan Mispereth Bigvai Nehum and Baanah This is the count of the men . . . of Israel
verses.literalPt: os quais vieram com Zorobabel, Jesua, Neemias, Azarias, Raamias, Naamani, Mordecai, Bilsã, Misperete, Bigvai, Neum e Baaná. O número dos homens do povo de Israel:

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔שׁ אַלְפַּ֕יִם מֵאָ֖ה וְשִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê p̄ar·‘ōš ’al·pa·yim mê·’āh wə·šiḇ·‘îm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: the descendants of Parosh 2,172 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Parós: dois mil e cento e setenta e dois.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁפַטְיָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê šə·p̄aṭ·yāh šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ šiḇ·‘îm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: the descendants of Shephatiah 372 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Sefatias: trezentos e setenta e dois.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אָרַ֔ח שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ’ā·raḥ šêš mê·’ō·wṯ ḥă·miš·šîm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: the descendants of Arah 652 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Ara: seiscentos e cinquenta e dois.

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי־ פַחַ֥ת מוֹאָ֛ב לִבְנֵ֥י יֵשׁ֖וּעַ וְיוֹאָ֑ב אַלְפַּ֕יִם וּשְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת שְׁמֹנָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- p̄a·ḥaṯ mō·w·’āḇ liḇ·nê yê·šū·a‘ wə·yō·w·’āḇ ’al·pa·yim ū·šə·mō·neh mê·’ō·wṯ šə·mō·nāh ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: the descendants of Pahath-moab through the line of Jeshua and Joab 2,818 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Paate-Moabe: dos filhos de Jesua e de Joabe, dois mil e oitocentos e dezoito.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עֵילָ֔ם אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ‘ê·lām ’e·lep̄ mā·ṯa·yim ḥă·miš·šîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh
verses.literal: the descendants of Elam 1,254 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Elão: mil e duzentos e cinquenta e quatro.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י זַתּ֔וּא שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê zat·tū šə·mō·neh mê·’ō·wṯ ’ar·bā·‘îm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh
verses.literal: the descendants of Zattu 845 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Zatu: oitocentos e quarenta e cinco.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י זַכָּ֔י שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê zak·kāy šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ wə·šiš·šîm
verses.literal: the descendants of Zaccai 760 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Zacai: setecentos e sessenta.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בִנּ֔וּי שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḇin·nui šêš mê·’ō·wṯ ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·mō·nāh
verses.literal: the descendants of Binnui 648 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Binui: seiscentos e quarenta e oito.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בֵבָ֔י שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḇê·ḇāy šêš mê·’ō·wṯ ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·mō·nāh
verses.literal: the descendants of Bebai 628 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Bebai: seiscentos e vinte e oito.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עַזְגָּ֔ד אַלְפַּ֕יִם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ‘az·gāḏ ’al·pa·yim šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: the descendants of Azgad 2,322 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Azgade: dois mil e trezentos e vinte e dois.

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ אֲדֹ֣נִיקָ֔ם שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ’ă·ḏō·nî·qām šêš mê·’ō·wṯ šiš·šîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh
verses.literal: the descendants of Adonikam 667 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Adonicão: seiscentos e sessenta e sete.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בִגְוָ֔י אַלְפַּ֖יִם שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḇiḡ·wāy ’al·pa·yim šiš·šîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh
verses.literal: the descendants of Bigvai 2,067 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Bigvai: dois mil e sessenta e sete.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י עָדִ֔ין שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ‘ā·ḏîn šêš mê·’ō·wṯ ḥă·miš·šîm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh
verses.literal: the descendants of Adin 655 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Adim: seiscentos e cinquenta e cinco.

verses.original: בְּנֵֽי־ אָטֵ֥ר לְחִזְקִיָּ֖ה תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ’ā·ṭêr lə·ḥiz·qî·yāh tiš·‘îm ū·šə·mō·nāh
verses.literal: the descendants of Ater through Hezekiah 98 . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Ater: de Ezequias, noventa e oito.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָשֻׁ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḥā·šum šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·mō·nāh
verses.literal: the descendants of Hashum 328 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Hassum: trezentos e vinte e oito.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י בֵצָ֔י שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḇê·ṣāy šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh
verses.literal: the descendants of Bezai 324 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Bezai: trezentos e vinte e quatro.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔יף מֵאָ֖ה שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָֽׂר׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḥā·rîp̄ mê·’āh šə·nêm ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: the descendants of Hariph 112 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Harife: cento e doze.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י גִבְע֖וֹן תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḡiḇ·‘ō·wn tiš·‘îm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh
verses.literal: the descendants of Gibeon 95 . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Gibeão: noventa e cinco.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית־ לֶ֙חֶם֙ וּנְטֹפָ֔ה מֵאָ֖ה שְׁמֹנִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê ḇêṯ- le·ḥem ū·nə·ṭō·p̄āh mê·’āh šə·mō·nîm ū·šə·mō·nāh
verses.literal: the men of Bethlehem and Netophah 188 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os homens de Belém e de Netofa: cento e oitenta e oito.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י עֲנָת֔וֹת מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê ‘ă·nā·ṯō·wṯ mê·’āh ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·mō·nāh
verses.literal: the men of Anathoth 128 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os homens de Anatote: cento e vinte e oito.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֥י בֵית־ עַזְמָ֖וֶת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê ḇêṯ- ‘az·mā·weṯ ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: the men of Beth-azmaveth 42 . . .
verses.literalPt: Os homens de Bete-Azmavete: quarenta e dois.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֨י קִרְיַ֤ת יְעָרִים֙ כְּפִירָ֣ה וּבְאֵר֔וֹת שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê qir·yaṯ yə·‘ā·rîm kə·p̄î·rāh ū·ḇə·’ê·rō·wṯ šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·lō·šāh
verses.literal: the men of Kiriath-jearim Chephirah and Beeroth 743 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os homens de Quiriate-Jearim, de Quefira e de Beerote: setecentos e quarenta e três.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָֽרָמָה֙ וָגָ֔בַע שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאֶחָֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê hā·rā·māh wā·ḡā·ḇa‘ šêš mê·’ō·wṯ ‘eś·rîm wə·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: the men of Ramah and Geba 621 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os homens de Ramá e de Geba: seiscentos e vinte e um.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִכְמָ֔ס מֵאָ֖ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê miḵ·mās mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: the men of Michmash 122 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os homens de Micmás: cento e vinte e dois.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֤י בֵֽית־ אֵל֙ וְהָעָ֔י מֵאָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê ḇêṯ- ’êl wə·hā·‘āy mê·’āh ‘eś·rîm ū·šə·lō·šāh
verses.literal: the men of Bethel and Ai 123 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os homens de Betel e de Ai: cento e vinte e três.

verses.original: אַנְשֵׁ֥י נְב֛וֹ אַחֵ֖ר חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’an·šê nə·ḇōw ’a·ḥêr ḥă·miš·šîm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: the men of the other Nebo 52 . . .
verses.literalPt: Os homens do outro Nebo, cinquenta e dois.

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ עֵילָ֣ם אַחֵ֔ר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ‘ê·lām ’a·ḥêr ’e·lep̄ mā·ṯa·yim ḥă·miš·šîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh
verses.literal: the descendants of the other Elam 1,254 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos do outro Elão: mil e duzentos e cinquenta e quatro.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḥā·rim šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ wə·‘eś·rîm
verses.literal: the descendants of Harim 320 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Harim: trezentos e vinte.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יְרֵח֔וֹ שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê yə·rê·ḥōw šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ ’ar·bā·‘îm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh
verses.literal: the men of Jericho 345 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Jericó: trezentos e quarenta e cinco.

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ לֹד֙ חָדִ֣יד וְאוֹנ֔וֹ שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאֶחָֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- lōḏ ḥā·ḏîḏ wə·’ō·w·nōw šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ wə·‘eś·rîm wə·’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: the men of Lod Hadid and Ono 721 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Lode, de Hadide e de Ono: setecentos e vinte e um.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י סְנָאָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וּשְׁלֹשִֽׁים׃פ
verses.transliteration: bə·nê sə·nā·’āh šə·lō·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm tə·ša‘ mê·’ō·wṯ ū·šə·lō·šîm
verses.literal: and the descendants of Senaah 3,930 . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Sanaá: três mil e novecentos e trinta.

verses.original: הַֽכֹּהֲנִ֑ים בְּנֵ֤י יְדַֽעְיָה֙ לְבֵ֣ית יֵשׁ֔וּעַ תְּשַׁ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שִׁבְעִ֥ים וּשְׁלֹשָֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hă·nîm bə·nê yə·ḏa‘·yāh lə·ḇêṯ yê·šū·a‘ tə·ša‘ mê·’ō·wṯ šiḇ·‘îm ū·šə·lō·šāh
verses.literal: The priests the descendants of Jedaiah through the house of Jeshua 973 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os sacerdotes: os filhos de Jedaías, da casa de Jesua: novecentos e setenta e três.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י אִמֵּ֔ר אֶ֖לֶף חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ’im·mêr ’e·lep̄ ḥă·miš·šîm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: the descendants of Immer 1,052 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Imer: mil e cinquenta e dois.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י פַשְׁח֔וּר אֶ֕לֶף מָאתַ֖יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê p̄aš·ḥūr ’e·lep̄ mā·ṯa·yim ’ar·bā·‘îm wə·šiḇ·‘āh
verses.literal: the descendants of Pashhur 1,247 . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Pasur: mil e duzentos e quarenta e sete.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י חָרִ֔ם אֶ֖לֶף שִׁבְעָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃פ
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḥā·rim ’e·lep̄ šiḇ·‘āh ‘ā·śār
verses.literal: and the descendants of Harim 1,017 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Harim: mil e dezessete.

verses.original: הַלְוִיִּ֑ם בְּנֵֽי־ יֵשׁ֧וּעַ לְקַדְמִיאֵ֛ל לִבְנֵ֥י לְהוֹדְוָ֖ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hal·wî·yim bə·nê- yê·šū·a‘ lə·qaḏ·mî·’êl liḇ·nê lə·hō·wḏ·wāh šiḇ·‘îm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh
verses.literal: The Levites the descendants of Jeshua through Kadmiel through the line of Hodevah 74 . . .
verses.literalPt: Os levitas: os filhos de Jesua, de Cadmiel, dos filhos de Hodeva, setenta e quatro.

verses.original: הַֽמְשֹׁרְרִ֑ים בְּנֵ֣י אָסָ֔ף מֵאָ֖ה אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ham·šō·rə·rîm bə·nê ’ā·sāp̄ mê·’āh ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·mō·nāh
verses.literal: The singers the descendants of Asaph 148 . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os cantores: os filhos de Asafe: cento e quarenta e oito.

verses.original: הַשֹּֽׁעֲרִ֗ים בְּנֵֽי־ שַׁלּ֤וּם בְּנֵֽי־ אָטֵר֙ בְּנֵֽי־ טַלְמֹ֣ן בְּנֵֽי־ עַקּ֔וּב בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיטָ֖א בְּנֵ֣י שֹׁבָ֑י מֵאָ֖ה שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וּשְׁמֹנָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: haš·šō·‘ă·rîm bə·nê- šal·lūm bə·nê- ’ā·ṭêr bə·nê- ṭal·mōn bə·nê- ‘aq·qūḇ bə·nê ḥă·ṭî·ṭā bə·nê šō·ḇāy mê·’āh šə·lō·šîm ū·šə·mō·nāh
verses.literal: The gatekeepers the descendants of Shallum the descendants of Ater the descendants of Talmon the descendants of Akkub the descendants of Hatita and the descendants of Shobai 138 in all . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Os porteiros: os filhos de Salum, os filhos de Ater, os filhos de Talmom, os filhos de Acube, os filhos de Hatita, os filhos de Sobai: cento e trinta e oito.

verses.original: הַנְּתִינִ֑ים בְּנֵי־ צִחָ֥א בְנֵי־ חֲשֻׂפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י טַבָּעֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: han·nə·ṯî·nîm bə·nê- ṣi·ḥā ḇə·nê- ḥă·śu·p̄ā bə·nê ṭab·bā·‘ō·wṯ
verses.literal: The temple servants the descendants of Ziha the descendants of Hasupha the descendants of Tabbaoth
verses.literalPt: Os netinins: os filhos de Zia, os filhos de Hasufa, os filhos de Tabaote,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ קֵירֹ֥ס בְּנֵי־ סִיעָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָדֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- qê·rōs bə·nê- sî·‘ā bə·nê p̄ā·ḏō·wn
verses.literal: the descendants of Keros the descendants of Sia the descendants of Padon
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Queros, os filhos de Sia, os filhos de Padom,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ לְבָנָ֥ה בְנֵי־ חֲגָבָ֖ה בְּנֵ֥י שַׁלְמָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- lə·ḇā·nāh ḇə·nê- ḥă·ḡā·ḇāh bə·nê šal·māy
verses.literal: the descendants of Lebanah the descendants of Hagabah the descendants of Shalmai
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Lebana, os filhos de Hagaba, os filhos de Salmai,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ חָנָ֥ן בְּנֵי־ גִדֵּ֖ל בְּנֵי־ גָֽחַר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḥā·nān bə·nê- ḡid·dêl bə·nê- ḡā·ḥar
verses.literal: the descendants of Hanan the descendants of Giddel the descendants of Gahar
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Hanã, os filhos de Gidel, os filhos de Gaar,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ רְאָיָ֥ה בְנֵי־ רְצִ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י נְקוֹדָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- rə·’ā·yāh ḇə·nê- rə·ṣîn bə·nê nə·qō·w·ḏā
verses.literal: the descendants of Reaiah the descendants of Rezin the descendants of Nekoda
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Reaías, os filhos de Rezim, os filhos de Necoda,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ גַזָּ֥ם בְּנֵי־ עֻזָּ֖א בְּנֵ֥י פָסֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḡaz·zām bə·nê- ‘uz·zā bə·nê p̄ā·sê·aḥ
verses.literal: the descendants of Gazzam the descendants of Uzza the descendants of Paseah
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Gazam, os filhos de Uza, os filhos de Paseia,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ בֵסַ֥י בְּנֵי־ מְעוּנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י נְפוּשְׁסִים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḇê·say bə·nê- mə·‘ū·nîm bə·nê nə·p̄ū·šə·sīm
verses.literal: the descendants of Besai the descendants of Meunim the descendants of Nephushesim
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Besai, os filhos de Meunim, os filhos de Nefussim,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ בַקְבּ֥וּק בְּנֵֽי־ חֲקוּפָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְחֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḇaq·būq bə·nê- ḥă·qū·p̄ā bə·nê ḥar·ḥūr
verses.literal: the descendants of Bakbuk the descendants of Hakupha the descendants of Harhur
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Bacbuque, os filhos de Hacufa, os filhos de Harur,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ בַצְלִ֥ית בְּנֵֽי־ מְחִידָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י חַרְשָֽׁא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḇaṣ·lîṯ bə·nê- mə·ḥî·ḏā bə·nê ḥar·šā
verses.literal: the descendants of Bazlith the descendants of Mehida the descendants of Harsha
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Bazlite, os filhos de Meída, os filhos de Harsa,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ בַרְק֥וֹס בְּֽנֵי־ סִֽיסְרָ֖א בְּנֵי־ תָֽמַח׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḇar·qō·ws bə·nê- sî·sə·rā bə·nê- ṯā·maḥ
verses.literal: the descendants of Barkos the descendants of Sisera the descendants of Temah
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Barcos, os filhos de Sísera, os filhos de Tama,

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י נְצִ֖יחַ בְּנֵ֥י חֲטִיפָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê nə·ṣî·aḥ bə·nê ḥă·ṭî·p̄ā
verses.literal: the descendants of Neziah and the descendants of Hatipha
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Nesias, e os filhos de Hatifa.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה בְּנֵי־ סוֹטַ֥י בְּנֵי־ סוֹפֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֥י פְרִידָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ‘aḇ·ḏê šə·lō·mōh bə·nê- sō·w·ṭay bə·nê- sō·w·p̄e·reṯ bə·nê p̄ə·rî·ḏā
verses.literal: The descendants of the servants of Solomon the descendants of Sotai the descendants of Sophereth the descendants of Perida
verses.literalPt: Os filhos dos servos de Salomão: os filhos de Sotai, os filhos de Soferete, os filhos de Perida,

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ יַעְלָ֥א בְנֵי־ דַרְק֖וֹן בְּנֵ֥י גִדֵּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ya‘·lā ḇə·nê- ḏar·qō·wn bə·nê ḡid·dêl
verses.literal: the descendants of Jaala the descendants of Darkon the descendants of Giddel
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Jaala, os filhos de Darcom, os filhos de Gidel,

verses.original: בְּנֵ֧י שְׁפַטְיָ֣ה בְנֵֽי־ חַטִּ֗יל בְּנֵ֛י פֹּכֶ֥רֶת הַצְּבָיִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אָמֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê šə·p̄aṭ·yāh ḇə·nê- ḥaṭ·ṭîl bə·nê pō·ḵe·reṯ haṣ·ṣə·ḇā·yîm bə·nê ’ā·mō·wn
verses.literal: the descendants of Shephatiah the descendants of Hattil the descendants of Pochereth-hazzebaim and the descendants of Amon
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Sefatias, os filhos de Hatil, os filhos de Poquerete-Hazebaim e os filhos de Amom.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַ֨נְּתִינִ֔ים וּבְנֵ֖י עַבְדֵ֣י שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת תִּשְׁעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- han·nə·ṯî·nîm ū·ḇə·nê ‘aḇ·ḏê šə·lō·mōh šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ tiš·‘îm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: The temple servants and descendants of the servants of Solomon numbered 392 . . . . . . . . . in all
verses.literalPt: Todos os netinins e os filhos dos servos de Salomão eram trezentos e noventa e dois.

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה הָֽעוֹלִים֙ מִתֵּ֥ל מֶ֙לַח֙ תֵּ֣ל חַרְשָׁ֔א כְּר֥וּב אַדּ֖וֹן וְאִמֵּ֑ר וְלֹ֣א יָכְל֗וּ לְהַגִּ֤יד בֵּית־ אֲבוֹתָם֙ וְזַרְעָ֔ם אִ֥ם מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh hā·‘ō·w·lîm mit·têl me·laḥ têl ḥar·šā kə·rūḇ ’ad·dō·wn wə·’im·mêr wə·lō yā·ḵə·lū lə·hag·gîḏ bêṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām wə·zar·‘ām ’im mî·yiś·rā·’êl hêm
verses.literal: The following came up from Tel-melah Tel-harsha Cherub Addon and Immer but they could not . . . prove that their families . . . were descended . . . from Israel . . .
verses.literalPt: Estes foram os que subiram de Tel-Melá, de Tel-Harsa, de Querube, de Adom e de Imer; porém não puderam provar que as suas famílias ou a sua linhagem eram de Israel;

verses.original: בְּנֵי־ דְלָיָ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ טוֹבִיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י נְקוֹדָ֑א שֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ḏə·lā·yāh ḇə·nê- ṭō·w·ḇî·yāh bə·nê nə·qō·w·ḏā šêš mê·’ō·wṯ wə·’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·nā·yim
verses.literal: the descendants of Delaiah the descendants of Tobiah and the descendants of Nekoda 642 in all . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: os filhos de Delaías, os filhos de Tobias, os filhos de Necoda: seiscentos e quarenta e dois.

verses.original: וּמִן־ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים בְּנֵ֥י חֳבַיָּ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הַקּ֑וֹץ בְּנֵ֣י בַרְזִלַּ֗י אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָ֠קַח מִבְּנ֞וֹת בַּרְזִלַּ֤י הַגִּלְעָדִי֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה וַיִּקָּרֵ֖א עַל־ שְׁמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- hak·kō·hă·nîm bə·nê ḥo·ḇay·yāh bə·nê haq·qō·wṣ bə·nê ḇar·zil·lay ’ă·šer lā·qaḥ mib·bə·nō·wṯ bar·zil·lay hag·gil·‘ā·ḏî ’iš·šāh way·yiq·qā·rê ‘al- šə·mām
verses.literal: And from among the priests the descendants of Hobaiah the descendants of Hakkoz and the descendants of Barzillai who had married . . . a daughter of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by their name
verses.literalPt: Dos sacerdotes: os filhos de Hobaías, os filhos de Coz, os filhos de Barzilai, que tomara por mulher uma das filhas de Barzilai, gileadita, e foi chamado do seu nome.

verses.original: אֵ֗לֶּה בִּקְשׁ֧וּ כְתָבָ֛ם הַמִּתְיַחְשִׂ֖ים וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָ֑א וַיְגֹֽאֲל֖וּ מִן־ הַכְּהֻנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh biq·šū ḵə·ṯā·ḇām ham·miṯ·yaḥ·śîm wə·lō nim·ṣā way·ḡō·’ă·lū min- hak·kə·hun·nāh
verses.literal: These men searched for their family records . . . but they could not find them and so were excluded from the priesthood as unclean
verses.literalPt: Estes procuraram os seus títulos nos registros genealógicos, porém não os encontraram; portanto, foram tidos como imundos e excluídos do sacerdócio.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַתִּרְשָׁ֙תָא֙ לָהֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יֹאכְל֖וּ מִקֹּ֣דֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁ֑ים עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד הַכֹּהֵ֖ן לְאוּרִ֥ים וְתוּמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hat·tir·šā·ṯā lā·hem ’ă·šer lō- yō·ḵə·lū miq·qō·ḏeš haq·qo·ḏā·šîm ‘aḏ ‘ă·mōḏ hak·kō·hên lə·’ū·rîm wə·ṯūm·mîm
verses.literal: The governor ordered them not to eat the most holy things . . . until there was a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim
verses.literalPt: O governador disse-lhes que não comessem das coisas santíssimas, até que se levantasse um sacerdote com Urim e Tumim.

verses.original: כָּל־ הַקָּהָ֖ל כְּאֶחָ֑ד אַרְבַּ֣ע רִבּ֔וֹא אַלְפַּ֖יִם שְׁלֹשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת וְשִׁשִּֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- haq·qā·hāl kə·’e·ḥāḏ ’ar·ba‘ rib·bō·w ’al·pa·yim šə·lōš- mê·’ō·wṯ wə·šiš·šîm
verses.literal: The whole assembly numbered 42,360 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Toda esta congregação junta eram quarenta e dois mil e trezentos e sessenta,

verses.original: מִ֠לְּבַד עַבְדֵיהֶ֤ם וְאַמְהֹֽתֵיהֶם֙ אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְשִׁבְעָ֑ה וְלָהֶ֗ם מְשֹֽׁרֲרִים֙ וּמְשֹׁ֣רֲר֔וֹת מָאתַ֖יִם וְאַרְבָּעִ֥ים וַחֲמִשָּֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: mil·lə·ḇaḏ ‘aḇ·ḏê·hem wə·’am·hō·ṯê·hem ’êl·leh šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm šə·lōš mê·’ō·wṯ šə·lō·šîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh wə·lā·hem mə·šō·ră·rîm ū·mə·šō·ră·rō·wṯ mā·ṯa·yim wə·’ar·bā·‘îm wa·ḥă·miš·šāh
verses.literal: in addition to their 7,337 . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . menservants and maidservants . . . as well as their 245 . . . . . . male and female singers . . .
verses.literalPt: afora os seus servos e as suas servas, dos quais havia sete mil e trezentos e trinta e sete, e tinham duzentos e quarenta e cinco cantores e cantoras.

verses.literal: They had 736 horses, 245 mules,
verses.literalPt: Os seus cavalos eram setecentos e trinta e seis; os seus machos, duzentos e quarenta e cinco;

verses.original: גְּמַלִּ֕ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑הס חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְעֶשְׂרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: gə·mal·lîm ’ar·ba‘ mê·’ō·wṯ šə·lō·šîm wa·ḥă·miš·šå̄·hs ḥă·mō·rîm šê·šeṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm šə·ḇa‘ mê·’ō·wṯ wə·‘eś·rîm
verses.literalPt: os seus camelos, quatrocentos e trinta e cinco; os seus jumentos, seis mil e setecentos e vinte.

verses.original: וּמִקְצָת֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֔וֹת נָתְנ֖וּ לַמְּלָאכָ֑ה הַתִּרְשָׁ֜תָא נָתַ֣ן לָאוֹצָ֗ר זָהָ֞ב דַּרְכְּמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ מִזְרָק֣וֹת חֲמִשִּׁ֔ים כָּתְנוֹת֙ כֹּֽהֲנִ֔ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miq·ṣāṯ rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ nā·ṯə·nū lam·mə·lā·ḵāh hat·tir·šā·ṯā nā·ṯan lā·’ō·w·ṣār zā·hāḇ dar·kə·mō·nîm ’e·lep̄ miz·rā·qō·wṯ ḥă·miš·šîm kā·ṯə·nō·wṯ kō·hă·nîm šə·lō·šîm wa·ḥă·mêš mê·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Some of the heads of the families contributed to the project The governor gave to the treasury 1,000 darics of gold 50 bowls and 530 . . . . . . priestly garments
verses.literalPt: Alguns dentre os cabeças das famílias contribuíram para a obra. O governador deu para a tesouraria mil daricos de ouro, cinquenta bacias e quinhentas e trinta vestes sacerdotais.

verses.original: וּמֵֽרָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽאָב֗וֹת נָֽתְנוּ֙ לְאוֹצַ֣ר הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה זָהָ֕ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִ֖ים שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֑וֹת וְכֶ֕סֶף מָנִ֖ים אַלְפַּ֥יִם וּמָאתָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·mê·rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ nā·ṯə·nū lə·’ō·w·ṣar ham·mə·lā·ḵāh zā·hāḇ dar·kə·mō·w·nîm šə·tê rib·bō·wṯ wə·ḵe·sep̄ mā·nîm ’al·pa·yim ū·mā·ṯā·yim
verses.literal: And some of the heads of the families gave to the treasury for the project 20,000 . . . darics of gold and 2,200 . . . minas of silver
verses.literalPt: Alguns dos cabeças das famílias deram para a tesouraria vinte mil daricos de ouro e duas mil e duzentas minas de prata.

verses.original: וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנוּ֮ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית הָעָם֒ זָהָ֗ב דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י רִבּ֔וֹא וְכֶ֖סֶף מָנִ֣ים אַלְפָּ֑יִם וְכָתְנֹ֥ת כֹּֽהֲנִ֖ים שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·šer nā·ṯə·nū šə·’ê·rîṯ hā·‘ām zā·hāḇ dar·kə·mō·w·nîm šə·tê rib·bō·w wə·ḵe·sep̄ mā·nîm ’al·pā·yim wə·ḵā·ṯə·nōṯ kō·hă·nîm šiš·šîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh
verses.literal: The rest of the people gave a total of 20,000 . . . darics of gold 2,000 minas of silver and 67 . . . priestly garments
verses.literalPt: O que o resto do povo deu foram vinte mil daricos de ouro, e duas mil minas de prata, e setenta e sete vestes sacerdotais.

verses.original: וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֡ם וְהַשּׁוֹעֲרִים֩ וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֨ים וּמִן־ הָעָ֧ם וְהַנְּתִינִ֛ים וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּגַּע֙ הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י וּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּעָרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·šə·ḇū hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·hal·wî·yim wə·haš·šō·w·‘ă·rîm wə·ham·šō·rə·rîm ū·min- hā·‘ām wə·han·nə·ṯî·nîm wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl bə·‘ā·rê·hem way·yig·ga‘ ha·ḥō·ḏeš haš·šə·ḇî·‘î ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·‘ā·rê·hem
verses.literal: So the priests Levites gatekeepers singers and temple servants along with some of the people and the rest of the Israelites settled in their own towns And by the seventh month the Israelites . . . had settled in their towns
verses.literalPt: Os sacerdotes, e os levitas, e os porteiros, e os cantores, e alguns dentre o povo, e os netinins, e todo o Israel habitaram nas suas cidades. Quando chegou o sétimo mês, já se achavam os filhos de Israel nas suas cidades.
